_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil statistics (5% of windows move ±2+) and absent liquidity confirmation (ETF flows near zero, stablecoin growth negative) mean there is no verified breaker to justify a directional call — HOLD is the skilled, statistically honest read.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls HOLD with medium conviction citing no breaker; narrative implies UP via mean reversion but provides no specific trigger; I side with the analyst's HOLD given the trust weight (7.67 vs 6.00) and the structural divergence evidence
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows spike above 30 AND stablecoin growth turns positive AND btc_momentum_30d holds above 45 — this would validate the August bottom analog and shift to Disbelief with UP direction
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows remain below 10 AND VIX breaks above 75 AND btc_momentum_30d falls below 40 — this would push the phase down to Anxiety or Panic, confirming the divergence is fatal to the bullish analog
